title: A New Perspective on ANN-to-SNN Conversion: Hardware-Aligned Multi-Threshold Neuron Dynamics for Neuromorphic Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.30277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: By accumulating spikes over multiple timesteps, rate coding approximates the real-valued activations of an ANN, a principle that underpins numerous ANN-to-SNN conversion methods. However, the converted SNNs typically incur loss in accuracy compared to the original ANN. Existing methods either increase a number of timesteps or introduce more complex neuronal dynamics to reduce this accuracy gap. Yet, both approaches ultimately lead to the same outcome: redundancy either in information or in computation, thereby suffering from efficiency degradation. translated_title: ANN到SNN转换的新视角：面向神经形态推理的硬件对齐多阈值神经元动力学
translated_abstract: 通过在多个时间步上累积脉冲，率编码（rate coding）能够近似人工神经网络（ANN）的实值激活值，这一原理支撑了众多ANN到SNN的转换方法。然而，转换后的SNN相比原始ANN通常会产生精度损失。现有方法要么增加时间步数量，要么引入更复杂的神经元动力学来缩小这一精度差距。但这两种方式最终都导致相同的结果：信息冗余或计算冗余，从而造成效率下降。为解决这一问题，我们提出PRIME（Potential-Residual Integration for Multi-threshold Encoding，面向多阈值编码的电位-残差集成），一个从硬件数据表示视角重新设计的多阈值并发脉冲神经元框架：a) 我们引入残差膜电位放大（RMPA）机制，用其替代率编码……（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PRIME框架，从硬件数据表示的视角重新设计多阈值并发脉冲神经元动力学，以残差膜电位放大机制替代传统率编码，消除ANN到SNN转换中的信息与计算冗余，在保证精度的同时提升神经形态推理效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PRIME, a hardware-aligned multi-threshold concurrent spiking neuron framework that replaces rate coding with residual membrane potential amplification, eliminating information and computation redundancy in ANN-to-SNN conversion for efficient neuromorphic inference with preserved accuracy.
